build_task_template: build a PHyRE task template that places a ball and jar with obstacles in a physics scene
create_static_bars: create angled static bars on the left and right sides of the scene as walls
add_dynamic_jar: add a dynamic jar to the scene at a configurable position and scale
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene positioned relative to an obstacle
update_task_relationship: update the task to require the ball touching the ball inside the jar
